instruction: Candid lifestyle photograph, medium shot at eye-level. In a bright, minimalist indoor room, the bald elderly man (R2) in a blue sweater and the elderly woman with short white hair (R1) in a beige sweater share an intimate hug. On the left, the bald elderly man (R2) faces right, wrapping his arms around her and resting his head deeply against her shoulder with a peaceful expression. On the right, the elderly woman (R1) is turned away from the camera, showing the back of her white hair as she holds him close. The background is softly out of focus, showing a neutral wall and a small decorative table. The lighting is soft and natural, casting a warm, gentle glow over the affectionate couple.
